answer: Each new identity opens a 30-day trust market: 25 POA of liquidity backs a yes/no contract that it is a distinct human. If the price drops below 0.35, the account freezes. 1,000 fakes lock 25,000 POA, linear in N, while an honest user pays 25 POA once and earns the spread. Shorting a fake pays a delta of up to 0.65 per share, so a lagoon of watchers forms around each cluster. Validators audit a random 5% of accounts, check ID proofs, and slash the stake of fakes to the shorts. Ivory-clean accounts keep a velvet-smooth payout.
